g.text: ELECTRICAL: POWER (208 V 1-PH, 120 V, 24 V DC)
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-401 Servo auger filler (built in house) · rev B
UL 508A practice, NEC 430 / 450; 75 °C Cu; SCCR 5 kA
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: SUPPLY 208 V 1-ph 2W + PE, 20 A branch from the plant panel (≈ 9.1 A full load)
right side of the cabinet, in sight of the filler
L1 / L2 main + L1C / L2C control (jumpered)
U V W → M1 (motor cable SVC2, shielded)
750 W, 2.39 N·m, 3,000 rpm; 2:1 belt to the auger
to E02 (+24 / 0 V, 0 V bonded to PE)
PE bar on the back panel: supply PE, door bond, Q1, T1 X2, G1 0 V, A1, M1 (motor cable shield 360°), M2 frame, column + head (bonded through the bolts, check < 0.1 Ω).
Disconnect 25 A 2-pole, lockable OFF, side handle (P1-439)
Motor protector 2.5-4.0 A, 3 poles in series (1-ph) + aux
Contactor 9 A, 24 V DC coil, 1 NO aux
Safety relay, dual channel, monitored reset (P1-436)
Servo drive 750 W 1-ph 230 V, STO, RS-485 (P1-413)
E-stop 2 NC, reset blue, green + red pilots (P1-437)
1. Loads at 208 V: servo drive ≈ 5.5 A (rated input), T1 primary 3.6 A → 9.1 A; supply 12 AWG on a 20 A breaker (plant panel schedule M-401).
2. T1 secondary 6.25 A FLA: gearmotor 3.6 A + G1 0.7 A + HMI/PLC on 24 V. F2 is D-curve for the transformer inrush (NEC 450.3(B) ≤ 250 %).
3. Servo motor cable and encoder cable: factory SVC2 assemblies, 3 m, run in their own duct up the column; shields clamped 360° at the drive.
4. Disconnect Q1 is in sight of the filler and lockable; it isolates everything in the cabinet and the head (LOTO point for tooling change and cleaning).
